about_the_game:
Nova Jumper is a one-of-a-kind first person platformer game that lets you parkour your way through levels and tackle hordes of enemies with friends or in VR.

STARRO'S ADVENTURE

  • Your goal as Starro™, the round space warrior being, is to long-jump through cartoonish levels in order to find a sheep that's gone missing.

  • You start in a spaceship where you are notified of your mission. After heading through the water portal, you are thrust into a long journey

CRAZY COMBAT!

  • Enemies shoot physical bullets at you, forcing you to dodge and weave your way through their attacks

ONLINE CO-OP

  • Why play alone when you can have Starro's™ friends join in on the fun?

  • Invite friends through IP to play through LAN (or use port forwarding to play from afar)

CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION

  • Customize your character with the menu found on the home screen.

  • Combine different colors with various skins to create your own unique character!

VIRTUAL REALITY (OCULUS CV1)

  • The Oculus CV1 has been tested to work with Nova Jumper

  • Immerse yourself in the game by aiming at enemies and shooting with your hand, while moving and jumping with the Rift controllers.

COOL STUFF!

  • 28 unique stages

  • Trampolines, motorcycles, and crippled interplanetary gravity all await you in Nova Jumper!
